clauses.title: Scope
clauses.text: Vendor shall supply office equipment and consumables as set forth in Schedule A.

clauses.title: Payment Terms
clauses.text: Customer shall pay invoiced amounts within sixty (60) days of receipt. Late payments accrue interest at 1.5% per month.

clauses.title: Liability
clauses.text: Vendor's aggregate liability shall not exceed the fees paid in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim.

clauses.title: Data Handling
clauses.text: Vendor will not collect personal data of Customer's employees beyond what is necessary for invoicing.

risk_findings.risk: Net 60 payment terms longer than standard Net 30
